name: Exterior Porch Floor Concrete Surface Preparation
intent: Concrete-specific prep. Moisture test (mandatory scheduling item), acid etch (QT3/QT4), diamond grind (QT5), crack fill, clean/degrease.
doctrine: Concrete prep. Moisture test mandatory (scheduling item — 60-72 hr for results). Acid etch at QT3/QT4 (CSP 2-3 for enamel). Diamond grind at QT5 only (CSP 3-5 for polyurea). Clean/degrease always. Crack fill from manual LF capture. No sun/temp/exposure modifiers.
